options for November 16
 By Data Skrive Nov. 16, 2026 1:45 pm EST Updated Share article 
 The Monday NHL schedule features the Utah Mammoth (10-8-3) hosting the Vancouver Canucks (4-17-1) at Delta Center, starting at 9:30 p.m. ET on ESPN+. The Mammoth rank eighth in the Western Conference with 23 points and the Canucks are 16th in the Western Conference with 9 points.
 How to watch Vancouver Canucks vs. Utah Mammoth
 Venue: Delta Center
 Time: 9:30 p.m. ET
 Streaming: ESPN+ (Sign in on ESPN+ with your Fubo account) 
 TV: ESPN+
 Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. 
 Vancouver vs. Utah odds
 Puck Line: Utah -1.5 (-138), Vancouver +1.5 (+111)
 Favorite Moneyline: Utah -355
 Underdog Moneyline: Vancouver +272
 Total: 6.5
 Total Over Odds: -118
 Total Under Odds: -105

 Mammoth
 John Marino: Out (Upper Body), 
 Maveric Lamoureux: Out (Shoulder), 
 Dylan Guenther: Out (Upper Body),

 Stats to know
 Clayton Keller has totaled 27 points in 21 games (five goals and 22 assists).
 In 15 games, Karel Vejmelka has conceded 45 goals (3.14 goals-against average) and has recorded 300 saves.
 Elias Pettersson has 23 points this season (1.0 per game), with six goals and 17 assists in 22 games (playing 20:33 per game).
 Leevi Merilainen has an .887 save percentage (35th in the league), with 402 total saves, allowing 51 goals (3.5 goals-against average).
